snippet.title: Sonic Advance: Unnamed Playthrough - Tails Gameplay (SAGE 2025 Demo)
snippet.description:
Sonic Advance Unnamed, formerly known as Sonic Advance Neo.

Tails flight is based on his upward momentum. Just like in the classics, flying before the peak of your jump increases the flight height, and starting flight while falling will mostly just continue your fall. Except more extreme.

The game: https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/sonic-advance-unnamed-sage-2025-demo.2786
